reserved_ranges.description: Compatibility fields for existing expected assets plus login, account, and base text fields. Existing meanings must remain stable.
Core character status fields such as hp, mp, level, exp, money, coordinates, and character state.
Battle state and skill slots such as battle_round, selected_target, skill_slot_1_name, and skill_slot_1_cooldown.
Quest, NPC, and dialog extension fields.
Modal, system notice, and blocking state fields.
Reward, inventory, item, and economy fields.
Map, navigation, scene, and coordinate extension fields.
System panel, form, and input fields.
Agent action hints and executable intent summaries.
Debug, compatibility, and experimental fields. Stable consumers should not depend on this range.
